datasets.name: DepositAccs
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM account ac
   WHERE
   kli_id = :CustID and
   val_acc =:val_acc AND
   (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accgroup
                           FROM sbcm_acc_zone_info_new
                          WHERE zoneid = (SELECT g.zoneid
                                             FROM sbcm_acc_zones_new g
                                            WHERE g.name = 'Deposit'))
         )
and close_dat is null
ORDER BY kli_id,accno

datasets.name: DepositPorps
datasets.sql:
SELECT cont.rowid,
       cont.opendate, 
       cont.closedate, 
       cont.amount, 
       cont.contractno, 
       cont.contracttype,
       cont.clienttype,
       cont.sid#, 
       cont.branchid,
       cont.Autopr, 
       cont.currency, 
       cont.personaltype,
       cont.customerid,
       cont.capitalperid,
       cont.periodid,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.GetpercentCollection(cont.id) as interest,
       ointr.overdueinterest,
       ointr.dueinterest,
       acc.contractaccid,
       acc.clientaccid,
       acc.interestaccid,
       acc.booroweraccid,
       acc.BEFO_INTERESTPEYTACCID,
       cont.firstinterestpaydat
  FROM sbcm_contracts_new cont,
       sbcm_overdueinterests_new ointr,
       sbcm_contract_accounts_new acc
 where 
      cont.id = :ContractID and     
      ointr.id# = :ContractID and
      acc.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: DepCapperiod
datasets.sql:
select id,period,description,periodid from sbcm_depcapitalperiods_new
where periodid = :periodid
order by period

datasets.name: DepPeriods
datasets.sql:
select id,period,description,depid,period_type from sbcm_depperiods_new

where depid = :depid
